title: Juventus top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most Serie A goals for Juventus since the start of 2000/01.

notes.Claudio Marchisio: Claudio Marchisio is just outside with 33 goals.
notes.Mario Mandzukic: Mario Mandzukic is just outside with 31 goals.
notes.Vincenzo Iaquinta: Vincenzo Iaquinta is just outside with 30 goals.

checks: Goals summed by Transfermarkt player id from every club season page; each club season checked against the table goals for (club_season_checks.csv). Each figure re-added from the player's own Transfermarkt game log, and from the season-by-season club table in the player's English Wikipedia article (Serie A seasons 2000/01 to 2025/26 only).
